titulo: Final project: DICA from start to finish at Clínica Vila Serena
lead: Time to bring it all together in a single dossier: the diagnosis from DICA 1 and the pieces from lessons 1 to 7, applied to Clínica Vila Serena, a fictional clinic. You assess the dossier against a rubric before calling it done, and you leave with a 90-day plan with dates. A real case is optional and only with written authorization.
objetivo: build the DICA dossier for Clínica Vila Serena, assess it against the rubric, and generate the 90-day plan with dates.

aprende.t: What goes in the dossier and in what order
Assess your own work against a rubric
Use a real case with authorization

hero_alt: A desk by a window with a bound dossier, an open notebook, and a cup of coffee; in the background, a clinic waiting room.

secoes.sub: Six pieces, in the order of the method. Click each one.

nos.detalhe: The one-page report from DICA 1, with the opportunity map and the recommendation. If you haven't done DICA 1, do the short version: the 5 areas and a recommendation with a reason.
The first assistant's sheet: what it does, what it doesn't do, official channel, path to a person, metric with the "before" number, and shutdown plan.
The playbook with a version, the "important" table, and the 3-phase chart with the agreed rule for moving up and going back.
The build decision and the 15-case test set from the last round, with no limit violated.
Roles sheet, script for the 90-minute training, one-page manual, and questions log.
Four weekly reports against the baseline, the maintenance scope, the 12-month map, and the pre-delivery checklist.

secoes.legenda: A cover page in front; the six pieces behind it. You write the cover last.

secoes.sub: Dossier index, rubric, and authorization for a real case.

blocos.conteudo:
DOSSIÊ DICA · <company> (<fictional | real with authorization>) · <date>

COVER (1 page, written last)
- the pain, with the "before" number
- the chosen assistant and what it does not do
- where it stands today (phase) and what changed against the baseline
- what comes next (maintenance, next area, or stop)

PIECES
1. Diagnosis (DICA 1) ........ 1-page report
2. First assistant sheet  lesson 1
3. Playbook + table + phases .... lessons 2 and 3
4. Decision + 15-case set ...... lesson 4
5. Roles + training + manual ..... lesson 5
6. Reports + scope + map ... lessons 6 and 7
7. Pre-delivery checklist ........ lesson 7
8. Completed rubric

RUBRIC · DICA DOSSIER · score from 0 to 4 on each criterion
Done when: all criteria at 3 or higher.

1. PAIN WITH A NUMBER
   0 no number · 2 number with no way to measure it · 4 baseline with date, who measured, and how

2. CLOSED SCOPE
   0 "complete assistant" · 2 does is described, does-not is vague · 4 one area, "does not" with 3+ items

3. SAFETY
   0 no phases · 2 phases without a written rule · 4 high risk in phase 1, path to a person
     tested, official channel, personal data with purpose and deadline

4. THE CLINIC USES IT WITHOUT YOU
   0 only the consultant operates it · 2 champion without a manual · 4 champion approves and adjusts on her own,
     manual at the front desk, questions log in use

5. FOLLOW-UP
   0 no report · 2 reports without a baseline · 4 four reports against the
     baseline, maintenance scope, and next step agreed (including stopping)

Scores: 1 <_> · 2 <_> · 3 <_> · 4 <_> · 5 <_>   Assessed by: <you | colleague>

AUTHORIZATION · use of the case as a study project

I, <owner's name>, responsible for <company>, authorize <consultant> to use
the work done in <period> as a final study project, under these conditions:

- use: <for study only | also as a published case>
- what appears: <aggregate numbers only | company name>
- what never appears: client names, phone numbers, and conversations; health data
- screenshots and recordings: only anonymized and approved by me beforehand
- I may withdraw this authorization at any time, by message

Date: <dd/mm/yyyy> · Signature or "agreed" message: <...>

exercicios.titulo: 1 · DICA dossier graded by the rubric
exercicios.texto: Build the dossier for Clínica Vila Serena (fictional) or for a real business with written authorization, write the cover last, and score it with the rubric. If you can, ask a colleague to score it too.
exercicios.pronto: the dossier has the cover and the 6 pieces, the rubric is filled in with a score of 3 or higher on all 5 criteria, and, if the case is real, the signed authorization is attached.

secoes.sub: 5 questions about the whole course. The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: What is the order of the deliverables after the diagnosis?
opcoes: Turn on, choose, follow up, and teach.
Choose, turn on, teach, and follow up.
Teach, choose, turn on, and follow up.
Follow up, teach, choose, and turn on.
perguntas.explica: Choose the first assistant, turn it on in phases with a tested playbook, teach the champion, and follow up. Each step uses what the previous one built.

perguntas.p: You don't have a real client. Does the final project still count?
opcoes: No: the project only counts with a paying client and a signed contract.
Only if you make up numbers similar to those of real clinics.
Only if the owner of a real clinic signs as a witness.
Yes: Vila Serena is fictional and labeled as such; a real case is optional, with authorization.
perguntas.explica: The method is the same with the fictional company. A real case is welcome, but only with written authorization and no patient data.

perguntas.p: On the rubric, the criterion "the clinic uses it without you" scores a 2. Is the dossier ready?
opcoes: No: every criterion needs a 3 or higher.
Yes, because the average of the 5 criteria is above 3.
Yes, if the other four criteria score a 4.
It depends on how satisfied the clinic was with the work.
perguntas.explica: The rubric doesn't average: every criterion needs a 3. A 2 here means a champion without a manual, and the assistant is left orphaned when you leave.

perguntas.p: What never leaves phase 1, at any point in the project?
opcoes: The greeting and the answers from the list of common questions.
The scheduling request with no money involved.
Anything that touches money, contracts, or health.
Messages received outside business hours.
perguntas.explica: High-risk items stay under human approval forever, even with no errors. The rest moves up a phase with a record and with the owner deciding.

perguntas.p: According to the course's view, what makes the owner trust the project?
opcoes: The most advanced and most expensive AI model available.
Diagnosis, phases with a way back, teaching, and follow-up with numbers.
Quickly building as many assistants as possible.
A long contract with a penalty for anyone who wants to leave.
perguntas.explica: Building got easy; trusting what was built did not. Trust comes from the method: diagnosis, a ladder with a way back, teaching, and numbers against the baseline.

itens.texto: High pain, low risk, clear scope, an official channel, and a shutdown plan.
A versioned playbook, 15 tested cases, and 3 phases with a way back.
A named champion, a 90-minute training, and a one-page manual.
A 20-minute check-in, 5 indicators against the baseline, and a cadence that tapers off.

secoes.titulo: What changed compared to the Customer Map (October 2026 update)

itens.texto: Official channel with a path to a person; general-purpose chatbot banned on the official platform since 01/15/2026; charging per delivered message since 07/01/2025, with 1,000 free service messages per number per month since 10/01/2026. Checked on 10/19/2026.
Amounts in reais and percentages without a source were removed. The phase criterion became a rule agreed with the owner; pricing is in Selling with AI.
The "ready-made packages" became diagnosis + INEMA open kit + follow-up, with 15 cases tested before going live.

itens.t: LGPD (Brazil's data protection law) and the project
itens.texto: Recordings, screenshots, and patient data only with a stated purpose, a time limit, and authorization. The final project uses a fictional company; a real case is optional.
